# Build session records

This folder holds what the build orchestrator writes while it builds the platform
(see `docs/plan/04-build-session.md`).

| Path | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `ownership.json` | Generated by `node scripts/build/ownership.mjs` from `docs/plan/build-packages.json`: every package id with the paths it owns. Read by the ownership checks. |
| `state.json` | The orchestrator's build state: each package's status, base commit, branch head, merge commit and attempts. |
| `dependency-requests/<id>.md` | One file per package that needs an npm package it may not install itself. Handled ones move to `dependency-requests/done/`. |
| `wave-log.md` | One entry per merge batch and gate: packages, attempts, fixers, migrations, gate durations, RAM and disk, end-to-end results, requests carried forward. |
| `seam-issues-v1.md`, `seam-issues-r2.md` | Seam failures found by the acceptance packages, each turned into a fix package. |
| `split-log.md` | Packages split after a failed retry, and why. |
| `logs/` | Gate step logs (git-ignored). |
